theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  refine (⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice ·, ?_⟩)
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor <;> intro s t <;> cases t <;> rename_i t
    all_goals first
      | exact ⟨_, .choiceR t, .bisim (.refl _)⟩
      | apply Exists.imp fun _ => And.imp Tr.choiceL ChoiceBisim.bisim
    exacts [h.follow_fst t, h.follow_snd t]
  | bisim h =>
    constructor <;> intro s t
    all_goals apply Exists.imp fun _ => And.imp id ChoiceBisim.bisim
    exacts [h.follow_fst t, h.follow_snd t]

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing c with
  | refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | par ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂ with
    | par hc hd =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha hc
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hd
      exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | red_I =>
      cases I_irreducible _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    | red_K =>
      obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., h⟩
    | red_S =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par h hb) (.par h' hb)⟩
  | _ =>
    cases h₂ with
    | par ha hb =>
      first
      | cases I_irreducible _ ha
        exact ⟨_, hb, .red_I _⟩
      | obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
        exact ⟨_, h, .red_K ..⟩
      | obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
        exact ⟨_, .par (.par h hb) (.par h' hb), .red_S ..⟩
    | _ => exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor⟩

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  refine (⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice ·, ?_⟩)
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  constructor <;> intro s t <;> cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    cases t <;> rename_i t
    case' choiceR => exact ⟨_, .choiceR t, .bisim (.refl _)⟩
    apply Exists.imp fun _ => .imp .choiceL .bisim
    first | exact h.follow_fst t | exact h.follow_snd t
  | bisim h =>
    apply Exists.imp fun _ => .imp id .bisim
    first | exact h.follow_fst t | exact h.follow_snd t

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing c <;> cases h₂
  case par.par ha hb iha ihb d e hc hd =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha hc
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hd
    exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
  all_goals try (solve | refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; constructor <;> assumption)
  all_goals try (solve | refine ⟨_, ?_, .refl _⟩; constructor <;> assumption)
  all_goals
    first
    | cases I_irreducible _ (by assumption)
    | obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ (by assumption)
    | obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ (by assumption)

    constructor <;> first
      | assumption
      | apply ParallelReduction.red_I
      | apply ParallelReduction.red_K
      | apply ParallelReduction.red_S

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let m := @mulLinearMap 𝓕
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let f := (m.flip.compl₂ (m.flip c)).flip.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF)
  let g := m.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp ((m c).comp timeOrderF))
  suffices h : f = g from congrArg (fun k => k a b) h
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro x y
  change ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis x * c * ofCrAnListFBasis y) =
    ι (c * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis x * ofCrAnListFBasis y))
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  conv_lhs =>
    simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
      List.singleton_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc, map_sub, map_smul,
      timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_comm, ← smul_sub]
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList,
      show x ++ φ :: ψ :: y = x ++ [φ, ψ] ++ y by simp,
      insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ x [φ, ψ] y (by simp_all),
      crAnTimeOrderList,
      show x ++ ψ :: φ :: y = x ++ [ψ, φ] ++ y by simp,
      insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ x [ψ, φ] y (by simp_all)]
    simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul]
    enter [2]
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← smul_mul_assoc,
      ← sub_mul, ← sub_mul, ← mul_smul_comm, ← mul_sub]
    rw [← map_smul, ← map_sub]
    rw [show ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ] - 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
      ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ] = c by
        simp [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
          ← ofCrAnListF_append]]
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
  simp only [mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
  rw [← insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ x y]
  simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
  by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
  · simp [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]
  · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by simp_all),
      ← crAnTimeOrderSign, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    simp only [c, map_mul, map_smul, mul_smul_comm, crAnTimeOrderList]
